InvestigationSupervisor.finding: Plan and Integrate V2 methods are fully implemented and unit-tested with mock/offline models. However, in ServiceManager._create_agent_orchestrator(), supervisor is passed as None, leaving the live server orchestrator without an active planning engine.

Specialist Delegation.finding: SourceSpecialistAgentFactory, PydanticAI bridge, tool execution, and proposal finalization are fully implemented and verified with TestModel. In ServiceManager, delegation_dispatcher is passed as None, meaning no dispatcher is wired to the live orchestrator.

ToolRegistry.finding: ForensicToolRegistry with read-only adapters (evidence, files, timeline, investigation_reads, platform_artifacts) is fully implemented, permission-checked, and observation-logged.

EvidenceResolver.finding: Resolves (task_id, evidence_key) tuples, enforces task isolation, extracts snapshot candidates, and prevents cross-task data leakage at database level.

GroundingValidator.finding: Validates model claims and citations against immutable evidence snapshots.

AgentWorkingStateV1.finding: Pydantic data models for working state, questions, coverage, hypotheses, contradictions, and directives. Persisted in SQLite with optimistic locking revision guards.

SupervisorIntegrationDecisionV2.finding: Schema V2, typed handle binding tables, and resolution to canonical transitions are fully implemented and verified across 16 benchmark seats and unit tests.

StateTransitionPolicy.finding: P2 deterministic transition engine, atomic commit gating, containment of invalid actions, and state revision increments (+1 per integration).

Semantic Verification.finding: SemanticVerifierAgent and review validators are implemented. Lazily wired into ServiceManager via _final_review_runner callback.

Analyst Review.finding: Explicit analyst review actions (accept, reject, invalid) with atomic transition tracking.

FinalizationGate.finding: Deterministic preflight and commit gates, blocking unresolved transition conflicts, requiring active run.

Audit / Trajectory Persistence.finding: Immutable append-only SQLite table agent_trajectory_events storing all cycle outcomes and validation failures.
